style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: Overhead 90-degree document flat-lay photograph on a warm oak desk in a home study. A cream paper project plan lies angled across the lower-left third, ruled rows holding faint illegible pencil strokes and one row left blank, its edge cropped by the frame. A brass mechanical stopwatch rests on the page corner, slightly rotated as if just set down, a hex pencil lying askew beside it. Soft window daylight from the left, gently diffused, casting long faint shadows to the right across the bare oak filling the upper right. Bone white, graphite and ochre palette, tactile paper stock and brushed brass, 60mm lens, deep focus with the oak grain falling softly away, fine film grain, no people, no legible text.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, legible numbers, watermarks, logos, human hands
rationale: The story's verdict is made on paper — the rule that settles it is minutes plus build, divided by 52 — so the hero is the artefact where that call happens: the hand-ruled project plan with its empty upkeep line, named in the article. A top-down document still life gives the stopwatch (the metered 2 minutes) physical weight against tactile paper stock, in the site's home-office world, without drifting into a generic desk-worker cliché.
cue: the upkeep line stay empty in every project plan
subject: a brass mechanical stopwatch resting on a paper project plan whose upkeep row is left blank
core_thesis: A hobbyist script must out-earn its own upkeep before it earns anything: a 2-minute weekly task returns 104 minutes a year while quarterly fixes burn 120, so the automation never pays for itself — the task must be worth at least 4.2 minutes a week to break even.
core_conflict: The visible saving of the automated task (104 minutes a year) versus the invisible, recurring upkeep that quietly outruns it (120 minutes a year plus an 8-hour build) — the upkeep line every home project plan leaves blank.
composition: Top-down 90-degree flat-lay, hero cluster pressed into the lower-left third with the page edge cropped by the frame, bare oak desk filling the upper right as breathing room
